t: Form I – Application for registration of establishment
when: Within 60 days of becoming applicable; existing registrations update by 8 Nov 2026
note: Online via Shram Suvidha (central sphere) or state portal; certificate issued in Form III within 7 days

t: Form XI – Notice of accident / dangerous occurrence
when: Death: forthwith; injury ≥ 48 h absence & dangerous occurrences: within 12 h
note: To Inspector-cum-Facilitator and District Magistrate/SDO; police and family for fatal. States issue equivalent forms under their OSH rules

t: Notice of accident / dangerous occurrence (legacy)
law: Factories Act s.88/88A; Karnataka Factories Rules 1969 / TN Factories Rules 1950
when: Fatal: immediate (phone/online) + written within prescribed hours; non-fatal > 48 h: 24 h; dangerous occurrence: as rule
note: Commonly 'Form 18' in both states — verify current form number and online submission on DFBISH/DISH portal

t: Notice of poisoning or occupational disease
law: OSH Code s.12 / Factories Act s.89 (Third Schedule)
when: Medical practitioner: forthwith; employer: as prescribed
note: Diseases include silicosis, asbestosis, NIHL, lead/chrome/benzene poisoning, dermatitis, byssinosis

t: Register of adult workers / attendance / leave with wages / overtime / wages
law: OSH Code s.33, Code on Wages; state rules
when: Maintained continuously; electronic permitted
note: Unified formats under Central Rules; legacy state form numbers differ

t: Register of accidents & dangerous occurrences; first-aid register; register of health examinations (dangerous operations)
law: OSH Code / state Factories & BOCW rules
when: Continuous; produce on inspection
note: Health records for carcinogen exposure retained long-term (verify rule – typically ≥ 30 years)

t: Annual / unified return
law: OSH Code s.33 & Central Rules; state rules
when: By date prescribed (commonly 1 Feb / 31 Jan for previous year – verify)
note: Includes accident statistics, headcount, hours, welfare

t: Register of lifting machines, chains, ropes & tackles; competent-person test certificate
when: Test every 12 months (lifting), 6 months (hoists/lifts, accessories in BOCW)
note: Form numbers per state rules (e.g. TN Rule 55A forms) — verify

t: Pressure vessel / plant examination report
when: External 6-monthly, internal 12-monthly, hydraulic test 4-yearly (verify)
note: By competent person recognised by Chief Inspector

t: Safety Officer appointment notification; Safety Committee constitution
when: On appointment; changes notified

t: Site notification (Schedule 7), Safety Report (Schedule 8), MSDS (Schedule 9), Major accident report (Schedule 6)
when: Site notification ≥ 3 months before; safety report before commencing & 3-yearly update; major accident 48 h
note: To Chief Inspector of Factories (DISH/DFBISH) for factories

t: On-site Emergency Plan; mock drill reports
when: Before commencement; rehearsed 6-monthly; off-site drill annual
note: Copy to District Collector / Crisis Group

t: Form 1/2 (HW authorisation), Form 3 (record), Form 4 (annual return), Form 10 (manifest), Form 11 (accident)
when: Form 4 by 30 June; Form 11 immediately on accident
note: SPCB online portals (KSPCB/TNPCB)

t: Form V – Environmental Statement
when: By 30 September each year
note: For units requiring consent/authorisation

t: Consent to Establish / Consent to Operate applications & renewals
law: Air Act s.21; Water Act s.25/26
when: CTE before construction; CTO before operation; renew before expiry
note: KSPCB / TNPCB online

t: C&D waste management plan & returns
when: With building permit for large projects; annual returns on portal (from 1 Apr 2026)

t: BOCW establishment registration; cess assessment return; worker beneficiary registration
law: OSH Code Ch. XIII / Code on Social Security Ch. VIII; state BOCW rules
when: Before commencing; cess within 30 days of completion/assessment (advance possible)
note: KBOCWWB (Karnataka) / TN Construction Workers Welfare Board

t: Contractor licence (all-India, 5-year) & principal employer registration
when: Before engaging 50+ contract workers

t: Form A – Notice of electrical accident
when: Within 48 h of knowledge (fatal – telephone/immediate)
note: To Electrical Inspector; preserve scene

t: Boiler accident report
when: Within 24 h
note: To Chief Inspector of Boilers

t: PESO licences (Form XIV/XV petroleum; LE forms explosives; cylinder/SMPV forms) & accident notice
law: Petroleum Rules 2002; Explosives Rules 2008; Gas Cylinders Rules 2016; SMPV(U) 2016
when: Before storage; accident: forthwith
note: Online PESO portal

t: Fire NOC application / renewal
law: Karnataka Fire Force Act 1964; TN Fire Service Act 1985; NBC Part 4
when: Provisional at plan stage; final before occupancy; renewal per state (annual/biennial)

t: Lift erection permission & licence
law: Karnataka Lifts Act 2012; TN Lifts and Escalators Act 1997
when: Before erection; licence before use; annual renewal

t: ESIC Accident Report (Form 12); Employee's Compensation fatal report
when: ESIC: 24 h; EC Commissioner: fatal within 7 days

t: OSHA 300 Log / 300A Summary / 301 Incident Report
when: 301 within 7 days; 300A posted 1 Feb–30 Apr; electronic submission by 2 March
note: Fatality 8 h; hospitalisation/amputation/eye loss 24 h (phone/online)

t: RIDDOR F2508 report
when: Death/specified injury: without delay (10 days); over-7-day: 15 days

t: Permit-to-work forms (hot, cold, confined space, excavation, electrical, WAH, radiography)
when: Per task; retain ≥ 1 year (3 years MAH)
note: Use the Permit Builder in this app

t: CCTS monitoring plan; verified GHG emission report (obligated entities)
law: Carbon Credit Trading Scheme 2023; EC Act 2001/2022
when: Monitoring plan before compliance year; verified report within 4 months of FY end (31 July)
note: Verification by Accredited Carbon Verification Agency; CCC issuance/surrender via ICM registry (first issuance 30 Sep 2026)

t: Energy audit report & annual energy return (Form 1/Form 2) – designated consumers
when: Energy audit periodicity per notification (typically 3 years); annual return by date notified
note: To State Designated Agency (KREDL Karnataka; EMC Tamil Nadu) and BEE; energy manager appointment

t: BRSR / BRSR Core with assurance statement
when: With annual report; assurance tier by market-cap rank (all top 1,000 from FY2026-27)
note: Value-chain (≥ 2% partners) assessment/assurance from FY2026-27

t: CBAM installation data & verification report (for EU customers)
when: Data to importer before their annual declaration (30 Sep 2027 for 2026 imports)
note: Importer must be an authorised declarant; default values carry 10–30% mark-ups

t: EPR registrations & annual returns (plastic, e-waste, battery, tyre, used oil)
law: Plastic Waste Rules 2016 (2022 EPR); E-Waste Rules 2022; Battery Waste Rules 2022; Tyre EPR 2022; HOWM 2nd Amendment 2023 (used oil, from 1 Apr 2024)
when: Registration before placing on market/handling; annual returns per portal (usually 30 June)
note: CPCB centralised portals; bulk consumers/generators keep hand-over records to registered recyclers

t: Lifting gear register & test/thorough-examination certificates (slings, chains, shackles, hoists)
law: Factories Act s.29 via state rules; BOCW rules
when: Before first use; 12-monthly (6-monthly for accessories where rules require)
note: Competent person recognised by Chief Inspector; forms per state rules

t: Tower crane erection/climbing test certificate; crane inspection logs
law: Factories Act s.29 via state rules; BOCW rules; OSHA 1926.1412 (US)
when: After each erection/climb and every 12 months; daily/monthly logs
note: Keep in cab; AAI height NOC where applicable

t: Dust Hazard Analysis report
law: NFPA 652 (good practice); Factories Act s.37 via state rules
when: Before operation; revalidate every 5 years
note: Supports insurer/Fire NOC requirements

t: Gas-free certificate; blind/isolation register (tank cleaning)
law: Factories Act s.36 via state rules; OISD-STD-105; API 2015
when: Before entry/hot work; each retest
note: Attach to permits; retain with permit records

t: Drone flight log & permissions
when: Each flight; zone permission before flight in yellow zones
note: Digital Sky portal

t: First-aid treatment register; first-aider certificates; box inspection log
law: Factories Act s.45 via state rules; OSH Code s.24; BOCW rules
when: Continuous; weekly box check; certificates valid 3 years
note: Produce on inspection; link entries ≥ 48 h absence to accident notice

t: Safety observation card / unsafe act & condition register; stop-work log
law: OSH Code s.6, s.22 (safety committee review); ISO 45001 cl. 5.4, 10.2
when: Daily cards; monthly trend to safety committee
note: Use the Observation card tool in this app
